dates.effective: Stylized statewide law in effect 1 January 2027

outcome.long: Housing units authorized by building permits, counted at permit issuance, all building sizes, in station areas: within ½ mile of rail and rapid transit stations and ¼ mile of bus routes running every 15 minutes. The law's addition is the number of extra homes permitted compared with current law.
outcome.rate_units: extra homes permitted per 1,000 existing homes in the station areas
outcome.short: Extra homes in issued building permits near major transit stops, compared with current law, Wisconsin, 2027–2031. Not completed homes.
